statement: Pinned Dolphin represents raw ten-bit acceleration, eleven core keys, status and ACK prefixes, 16-byte read chunks, and input payload lengths 2,5,10,17,21 for modes0x30..0x37 and0x3d..0x3f. Modes0x38..0x3c are reserved and not emitted. Basic IR packs two ten-bit coordinate pairs in five bytes; extended IR uses three bytes per point. IR visibility and blob metadata are separate; C5 full-IR metadata is not established as physical fidelity.
